text: A good relationship can teach you self-love too, which is part of the problem: you may need one most when you’re least capable of creating a good one, recognizing one, or keeping it good. Whether you should be in one depends on what you and the other person are ready for and have the resources for. Here’s a video that can help understand the long process.
